plugin.name: Driver Parallel Lines Fusion Fix
MinResX.description: Filter display modes by minimum width. 0 uses 640 pixels. The list keeps at most 100 modes, prioritizing the highest resolutions.
MinResY.description: Filter display modes by minimum height. 0 uses 480 pixels.
MaxResX.description: Filter display modes by maximum width. 0 means no maximum.
MaxResY.description: Filter display modes by maximum height. 0 means no maximum.
ForceMaxRefreshRate.description: Show each resolution only at its highest supported refresh rate. Disable to list every supported refresh rate.
FOVFactor.description: Multiplies the corrected gameplay field of view. 1.0 keeps the intended framing; larger values widen the view. Applies to the next camera update.
SMAA.description: Apply spatial SMAA postprocessing. It does not work with native MSAA.
ConsoleGamma.description: Apply a more contrasted gamma curve with deeper colors.
Enable.description: Allow free mouse look. This disables the native Look Left, Look Right and Look Back actions.
CameraReturnTimeout.description: Seconds to wait before the free-look camera returns to its original position.
CameraReturnSpeed.description: Speed at which the free-look camera returns to its original position.
TurnIndicators.description: Activate vehicle indicators automatically while turning.
ManualTurnIndicators.description: Use the configured keyboard keys or gamepad LB/RB to activate turn indicators manually.
LeftIndicatorKey.description: Windows virtual-key code for the left indicator. Default 219 (0xDB) is the left bracket key.
RightIndicatorKey.description: Windows virtual-key code for the right indicator. Default 221 (0xDD) is the right bracket key.
MAIN.TextLanguage.description: Language tag for Plugins and other plugins. auto follows the game language. Edit in the hub or CFG, then reopen Plugins.
menu.title: Plugins
menu.presethelp: Vanilla: as released. Recommended: the defaults. Enhanced: everything turned up.
menu.settingsfilehelp: Shows the settings file in File Explorer
ConfineCursor.description: Keep the cursor inside the active game client area. Releases on focus loss, window dragging, system menus or when disabled. Independent of mouse input.
menu.restoredefaultshelp: Sets the settings of this page to their defaults.
menu.restartwarning: The game must be restarted to apply some settings.
WindowMode.description: Fullscreen, a centered window at the selected resolution, or borderless at the monitor resolution. Restart required. Alt+Enter switches between fullscreen and the last window mode.
FPSLimit.description: Limit rendered frames per second. 0 is Unlimited; Monitor follows the active display refresh rate. Applies immediately.
MAIN.PauseOnFocusLoss.description: Pauses the game while another window is active.
MAIN.MouseSensitivity.description: Multiplies mouse camera movement; 1 keeps the game profile sensitivity.
MAIN.InvertMouseY.description: Invert vertical mouse look relative to the game profile.
MAIN.RawInputMouse.description: Preserve relative mouse counts between controller updates and retain fractional cursor movement. Off uses the native per-update response. Immediate DirectInput polling remains enabled.
MAIN.Vibration.description: Allows the game’s native force feedback. Off stops active effects. Vibration is also suppressed while the window is inactive or the developer overlay blocks gameplay.
MAIN.GamepadDeadzone.description: Native controller stick deadzone. Applies once to movement and camera input. Lower values respond sooner; raise it if the sticks drift.
MAIN.GamepadIcons.description: Native controller button pictures: Xbox, PlayStation or Nintendo. Auto uses Xbox. Keyboard and mouse names stay unchanged.
MAIN.CheckForUpdates.description: Once per start, asks fusionfix.io whether a newer version of the fix is out and tells you in the game. Off makes no network request.
update.availablehub: {name} {version} is available. FusionFixHub opens when you close the game.
MAIN.FMVWidescreenMode.description: Original aspect shows the movies as the game does, whole inside its centred 4:3 frame with black bars around them. Fill fits the whole movie to the screen, without cutting anything off or stretching it.
MAIN.HudAspectRatioConstraint.descriptio: Limit HUD width to an aspect ratio. Auto follows the display.
